2026 2nd ICAIFI 

All accepted papers MUST BE presented orally (offline) or virtually (online) at the Conference to be published in the proceedings; otherwise, they will not be published in the proceedings. Only accepted and presented papers will be submitted to IEEE Xplore for possible inclusion, provided that they meet IEEE Xplore's scope and quality requirements. Publications included in the IEEE Xplore Digital Library are generally indexed in SCOPUS.

Please take the steps below after your paper has been ACCEPTED. 

  1. Please register and pay for the conference through the EDAS system.
  2. Please download the Camera-Ready of IEEE Full Paper A4 Template: https://bit.ly/IEEETemp
  3. Send the revised full paper in the IEEE PDFXpress format (see Instructions for IEEE PDFXpress with ID of 73380X.
  4. Please be aware that, according to IEEE regulations, the maximum similarity score must be less than 30% when using i-Thenticate. 
  5. Login to EDAS, and fill in the Electronics Copyright Form (eCF) and Presenter. 
  6. The status will be changed to COMPLETED.
  7. The conference will be conducted as a Hybrid conference (online + offline)

For more details:
